storySections.title: Build Growth Around the Instagram Account You Actually Have
paragraphs: There is no universal package that makes sense for every account.

A newer creator may want to start with a smaller follower increase. An established creator may care more about an important Reel. An ecommerce brand may focus on Likes or Views around a product launch. A local business may want the overall profile to look more established before a campaign sends new visitors toward it. An agency may use completely different services across different client accounts.
Start with where the account is now. Decide which metric needs attention. Then choose the package that fits.
Instagram growth should support the strategy. Not replace it.
